action.why: Everyone sits near Lv 42; rank EXP for all 15 banks the A ranks the Part III Master exams ask for. Last chapter with facilities.

blessings.why: Negates effective damage on the turn the Dragoons hit your fliers.
Avo +50 when the elephants charge the line.

deploy.note: 13 slots: Lilian, Nuzzuo and Bonaventure's Cutting Gale for the Dragoons; Tobias's Triple Spike on elephants; Nydine rides out to the side Dragoons. Noctula and Simon sit (Group Drills still rank them).

missables.text: Last chapter with facilities: spend every License, Support and the Army Action now.
missables.lose: Free exams and Supports until Part III

tips.text: Advance slowly: reinforcements come from the south end of the bridge behind you
Clear the side Dragoons first; they're limited
Bait an elephant charge with a high-Move unit stepping in and out of its vision
Gang up on Lind behind his elephants
